docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,000.25 FILED BY COLE ALMA AS TO DEFENDANT PAGGETT ARVEAL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-04-1992 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 05

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF COLE ALMA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PAGGETT ARVEAL $2,000.25 PRINCIPAL, $28.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,028.25 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
